guard: Incomplete manager renewal compensates only its own created rows, preserves reused active rows, retains missing-row cleanup debt, and refuses another issuance while debt remains.
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm smoke:manager-renewal-compensation

mutations.name: missing created ledger row silently clears cleanup debt
mutations.find:
if (!ledger)
        throw new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", `manager renewal ${role} cleanup found no atomically created ledger row; reconciliation remains required`);
mutations.expectRed: missing created row: cleanup remains explicit debt

mutations.name: wrapper delegates a reused row to lost-CAS revocation
mutations.expectRed: wrapper reused: lost-CAS revoke ownership is conserved

mutations.name: real KV gate revokes its reused row
mutations.expectRed: real gate: ordinary identical reuse records ownership and skips same-instance revoke

mutations.name: new issuance ignores a prior unresolved revoke failure
mutations.find:
if (failed.length > 0)
        throw primaryWithCleanupDebt(new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", "a prior manager renewal has unresolved cleanup debt; refusing to mint another generation"), failed);
mutations.replace:
if (failed.length < 0)
        throw primaryWithCleanupDebt(new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", "a prior manager renewal has unresolved cleanup debt; refusing to mint another generation"), failed);
mutations.expectRed: cleanup debt: survives a real authority plane close and reopen

mutations.name: compensation processes only one owned row
mutations.expectRed: after-goal-finalize: every owned row is retained revoked

mutations.name: atomic create reports reuse instead of ownership
mutations.expectRed: wrapper created: stage records the real gate's atomic row ownership
